title: Rehab center
description: A bright rehabilitation therapy hall with connected areas for supported walking, mobility practice, transfers, fitted aids, exercise and daily living. Adjustable equipment and movable accessories share clear circulation routes. Furnishings and accessories use rigid physical approximations.

tasks.text: Lift the light dumbbell from the upper tray of the cart beside the workbench. Set it on the workbench near the front edge, directly in front of the tray holding the two cuffs and at the end nearest the cart.

locatorSteps.label: Lift the light dumbbell from the cart’s upper tray.
Set it in front of the cuff tray at the cart end.

tasks.text: Find the bowl on the kitchen cabinet countertop next to the two cups. Push it 20 cm along the front edge of the counter toward the sink, away from the cups.

locatorSteps.label: Push the bowl 20 cm along the counter toward the sink.

tasks.text: Move the trolley carrying the harness and training dummy along the ceiling support track. Pass the halfway point and continue until the dummy is 2 m from its starting position. Release the trolley and leave it still with the dummy supported by the harness.

locatorSteps.label: Move the loaded trolley past the midpoint.
Continue to 2 m from the starting point.
Release the trolley and let it stop.
Check that the harness still supports the dummy.

tasks.text: On the parallel bars, use the rail closest to the floor mat. Withdraw its locking pin, raise that rail 12 cm, then reinsert the pin. Press down on the rail to check that it holds its new height.

locatorSteps.label: Withdraw the pin on the rail nearest the mat.
Raise that rail 12 cm.
Reinsert the locking pin.
Press down to check that the rail holds.

tasks.text: Park the wheelchair beside the plinth and engage both brakes. Lift the armrest on the plinth side and swing the footrests and footplates clear. Raise the plinth, then lift the transfer board from its top and lay it across the gap with one end on the wheelchair seat and the other on the plinth. Release the board and press down to check that both ends stay supported.

locatorSteps.label: Park beside the plinth and engage both brakes.
Lift the armrest on the plinth side.
Swing the footrests and footplates clear.
Raise the plinth.
Lift the board off the plinth.
Bridge the wheelchair seat and plinth with the board.
Release and press down to check both ends hold.

tasks.text: Facing the pair of foot pedals on the loaded plinth beside the wheelchair, press the left pedal to raise the top 12 cm above its starting height. Release it and let the top hold. Press the right pedal to lower the top to 3 cm above its starting height, then release it and let the top hold again.

locatorSteps.label: Press the left pedal to raise the top 12 cm.
Release the pedal and let the top hold.
Lower to 3 cm above the start with the right pedal.
Release the pedal and let the top hold again.

tasks.text: Withdraw the locking pin below the pedal trainer’s seat. Slide the seat 8 cm along its adjustment rail, away from the pedals. Reinsert the pin, then push on the seat to check that it stays in place.

locatorSteps.label: Withdraw the pin beneath the seat.
Slide the seat 8 cm away from the pedals.
Reinsert the seat pin.
Push on the seat to check that it holds.

tasks.text: Slide the entire ramp lengthwise toward the training stairs. Move it halfway first, then continue until it is 35 cm from its starting position. Release the ramp and leave it upright and still.

locatorSteps.label: Slide the ramp halfway toward the training stairs.
Continue to 35 cm from its starting position.
Release it upright and let it come to rest.

tasks.text: Face the kitchen cabinet and open the left of the two doors directly beneath the cutlery drawer. With that door open, pull the drawer out 30 cm. Push the drawer fully back in, then close the door and leave both still.

locatorSteps.label: Open the left door beneath the cutlery drawer.
Pull the drawer out 30 cm.
Push the drawer fully closed.
Close the cabinet door and leave both still.

tasks.text: At the washing machine beside the dryer, open the front door and turn the empty drum half a turn by hand. Close the door and leave both the door and the drum still.

locatorSteps.label: Open the front door of the washing machine.
Turn the empty drum half a turn by hand.
Close the door and leave it and the drum still.
